title: Risk-Controlled DFT Selection for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
abstract: arXiv:2610.19630v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated materials discovery requires evaluating large pools of candidate configurations, with density functional theory (DFT) as a major throughput bottleneck. Pretrained machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate DFT cheaply, but their errors vary by orders of magnitude across configurations, making it difficult to decide when to trust the MLIP predictions and when to fall back to DFT. We frame this decision as a risk-controlled selection problem and solve it within a conformal risk control (CRC) framework. Each configuration is mapped from atomic numbers and Cartesian coordinates to a fixed geometric descriptor, which a lightweight predictor uses to estimate an MLIP-DFT disagreement score in energy, average force, and maximum force. CRC then calibrates this score into a selection threshold for DFT labeling such that the MLIP error on the unselected configurations, which keep their MLIP labels, stays below a user-cho

translated_title: 面向机器学习原子间势的风险控制DFT选择方法
translated_abstract: 自动化材料发现需要评估大量候选构型，而密度泛函理论（DFT）计算是主要的通量瓶颈。预训练的机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）能够以低成本近似DFT，但其误差在不同构型之间可能相差数个数量级，这使得难以决定何时应该信任MLIP的预测、何时应回退到DFT计算。我们将这一决策问题构建为风险控制选择问题，并在保形风险控制（CRC）框架内进行求解。该方法将每个构型从原子序数和笛卡尔坐标映射为固定的几何描述符，轻量级预测器利用该描述符估计能量、平均力和最大力方面的MLIP-DFT不一致分数。随后，CRC将该分数校准为DFT标记的选择阈值，使得未被选中的构型（保留其MLIP标签）上的MLIP误差保持在用户指定的水平以下，从而在保证预测质量的同时大幅减少所需的DFT计算量。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于保形风险控制（CRC）的框架，利用轻量级预测器估计MLIP与DFT之间的不一致分数并校准为选择阈值，在保证MLIP误差可控的前提下自动决定哪些构型需要昂贵的DFT计算，从而突破自动化材料发现的通量瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a conformal risk control (CRC) framework that uses a lightweight predictor to estimate MLIP-DFT disagreement scores and calibrates them into selection thresholds, automatically deciding which configurations require expensive DFT calculations while keeping MLIP errors below user-specified levels, thereby overcoming the throughput bottleneck in automated materials discovery.
